columns.description: Salary Start Date

columns.description: Salary End Date

columns.name: BASIS_SIMPLE_COMPONENT_ID
columns.description: Unique key of setup entity cmp_basis_simple_components

columns.name: DISPLAY_SEQUENCE
columns.description: Display sequence will be used display in ascending order

columns.name: PROCESSING_SEQUENCE
columns.description: Processing order of the rates user entered will usually be first and then computed rates

columns.name: COMPONENT_TYPE
columns.description: Simple Rate type as defined in the salary basis

columns.name: COMPONENT_CODE
columns.description: Rate component code which is user defined lookup code

columns.name: BASED_ON_COMPONENT_CODE
columns.description: If Rate is percentage based then the rate on which the amount will be computed during allocation time.

columns.name: OVERALL_SALARY_AFFECT
columns.description: If the rate amount would be added to the overall salary rate if present in the salary basis definition.

columns.name: INPUT_VALUE_ID
columns.description: Input Value Id of the element type attached to salary basis to which the element entry will be created.

columns.name: USER_SELECTED_COMPONENT
columns.description: If the simple rate is a user selected one from the salary basis which are defined as user selectable at allocation time

columns.name: DEFAULT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Default Amount if defined in the setup for the simple rate

columns.name: PREV_AMOUNT
columns.description: Pervious component amount for the same salary basis

columns.name: PREV_ADJUSTMENT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Previous Adjustment Amount for the component for the same salary basis, it will be null for first salary record.

columns.name: PREV_ADJUSTMENT_PERCENT
columns.description: Previous Adjustment Percentage for the component of the same salary basis.

columns.name: AMOUNT
columns.description: Rate Amount which can be user entered or computed

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency Code as defined in the salary basis

columns.name: FREQUENCY_CODE
columns.description: Frequency as defined in the salary basis

columns.name: SCALE
columns.description: Rate number of decimal points as defined in the salary basis

columns.name: ROUNDING_CODE
columns.description: Rounding Code as defined in the salary basis

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Adjustment Amount with respect to previous salary record provided it also has the same basis and simple rate

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_PERCENT
columns.description: Adjustment Percent with respect to previous salary record provided it also has the same basis and simple rate

columns.name: PERCENTAGE
columns.description: Rate Percentage user entered or fixed

columns.name: ANNUAL_FACTOR
columns.description: Annual Factor as defined in salary basis

columns.name: ANNUAL_AMOUNT
columns.description: Annual Amount with FTE applied

columns.name: ANNUAL_FT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Annual Amount without the FTE applied i.e. full-time amount

columns.name: MINIMUM_AMOUNT
columns.description: Minimum check for the Rate Amount entered or computed.

columns.name: MAXIMUM_AMOUNT
columns.description: Maximum check for the Rate Amount entered or computed.

columns.description: OVERRIDE_GSP_RATE

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: AUDIT_ACTION_TYPE_
columns.description: Action Type - have values like INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE.

columns.name: AUDIT_CHANGE_BIT_MAP_
columns.description: Used to store a bit map of 1s and 0s for each column in the table.
